title: Close after the landlord personally handles the repair and confirms completion

semantic_requirements.description: Attribute work_confirmed_by to the landlord and cite event 011 or 012.
Limit closure to the shower issue in this case; do not claim that all historical property issues have been resolved.
Do not invent contractor charges or payment evidence.

prohibited_behaviors: Claiming that an agency contractor performed the work or that charges have been paid.
Claiming that earlier smoke detector/ceiling topics have also been resolved.

provenance.derivation: Event 006 states that the landlord will obtain and fit the parts; 011/012 record landlord confirmation of completion twice. Historical event 013 marks the task complete without agency payment. Map to close_case(work_completed), with the landlord as both the person handling and confirming the work. If used, keys=not_issued and invoice=not_required are inferred tool fields supported by the absence of agency assignment/key collection and the landlord handling the repair; they are not explicitly stated in the source. Do not treat these enums as direct historical labels or independently scored criteria.
provenance.review_scope: Historical prefix events 001–012 and the reference action; later events are not inputs or required facts.

grading.action_source: Use recorded CaseState.actions or tool entries in traces, not only model statements or the status in ANSWER.md.
grading.rule: The run may take several actions. A successful action must match an allowed branch (name and exact_arguments); the run must end on that action, or on hold or escalate after it (close_case only when it is the matched branch); no guard may refuse an action. Sum semantic_requirements weights over the matched action and normalize to a score from 0 to 4. A prohibited behavior in any action of the run yields 0. History is not the only acceptable answer; alternative paths may be retained for manual review.
grading.tool_error: A failed/refused tool is not successful execution. Record the failure; do not manually fix the answer.
grading.semantic_review: Assess message/argument semantics against the visible input and labels. Do not treat new facts in future reference_actions as facts already known to the agent.
